messages.content:
Our Dockerfile:
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
ENV NODE_ENV=production
EXPOSE 3000
USER node
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
Why is npm ci used instead of npm install?
npm ci installs exactly what package-lock.json specifies and fails if it disagrees with package.json, which makes container builds reproducible.
Is running as USER node a good idea?
Yes. Running as the unprivileged node user limits what a compromised process can do inside the container.
Switch the base image to node:22-slim. Nothing else should change.
